Dear Sir,

I am writing to request a loan of 2 lakh rupees for my sister's marriage. I assure you that I will repay this amount over a period of 24 months.

Currently, I hold the position of store supervisor with four years of experience and earn a monthly salary of 45,000 rupees. Additionally, I am already repaying a bike EMI of 6,000 rupees per month and have never missed any payment.

I kindly request that you consider my application for this loan.

Thank you for your time and consideration.

Sincerely,
[Your Name]
